judgment.rationale: Both are BASIC 1 Indicators (same rank 0) under the same Content Standard B1.2.2.1 'Connect sounds to letters and blend letters/syllables in order to read and write' in Reading/Phonics, so grain and domain match. Fluent recognition and production of individual letter sounds supports success in segmenting syllables/words into those sounds, and the indicator ordering within the same table (row 1 vs row 3) is consistent with that direction; it is not asserted as a mandatory prerequisite. Evidence limitation: source evidence for both SFIs and LC metadata for the second SFI are truncated, so only the bounded excerpts and codes were used.
